title: AT Protocol annotations
description: Cards shown beside tent.io page sections when ATPROTO_ANNOTATIONS is set, pointing at the closest AT Protocol concept.

page.description: Built page path, as Middleman's current_page.path reports it, e.g. docs/posts.html

heading.description: id of the heading whose section the card sits beside

tent.description: Short Tent term for the card's first chip, e.g. type URI

atproto.description: Short AT Protocol counterpart for the card's second chip, e.g. Lexicon NSID

summary.description: Markdown. How the Tent concept maps to AT Protocol, differences included

url.description: Official AT Protocol docs, or Bluesky's developer docs for Bluesky record types
